subject: Release memo — Clun 0.3.0 (shared-memory workers and zero-stubs close)
opening: Bottom line: Clun 0.3.0 is the minor train that lands shared-memory multithreading (SharedArrayBuffer, Atomics, real worker_threads) and closes the zero-stubs inventory so exported Node and runtime surfaces are not hollow no-ops. Capability matrix remains 30 Yes / 0 Partial / 0 No. Until this candidate publishes, the installable boundary stays v0.2.2.

sections.heading: 1. Why
sections.body: Full-port law forbids soft Yes and hollow exports. Workers without real shared memory, and Node surfaces that ignore arguments and return undefined, break the exceed-Bun contract. Issues #338 and #339 complete that unit for the 0.3.0 minor release.

sections.heading: 2. What changed
items: SharedArrayBuffer, Atomics, and real worker_threads (Issue #338 / PR #340)
WASI path_open, fd_read, and path_filestat_get against host files (pure CL)
process.stdout and process.stderr end plus writableEnded stream semantics
MessagePort start records _started; Node-compatible auto-start retained
WebSocket wss: via pure-tls worker path (related surface train)
Source version staged 0.3.0; release ledger candidate tracks Issue #339

sections.heading: 3. SemVer disposition
sections.body: Impact: minor. Rationale: backward-compatible capability completion (shared-memory multithreading and residual destubs). Version: 0.3.0. Tag: v0.3.0. Previous published boundary: 0.2.2 / v0.2.2. Pre-1.0 note: minor versions on the 0.x train may still include breaking changes per project SemVer policy.

sections.heading: 4. Intentional design no-ops (not hollows)
items: MessagePort start: records _started; ports auto-start as in Node
crypto FIPS: always reports 0; pure-CL crypto is not FIPS-validated
os.setPriority for foreign pids: SystemError (no forbidden kernel niceness API)

sections.heading: 5. Gates completed on the close unit

steps.text: make test (JS and TS fixtures green; parachute Failed: 0)
Mechanical ignore-args hollow scan: zero product hollows

sections.heading: 6. Install note (publication state)
sections.body: While the candidate remains unpublished, curl -fsSL https://clun.sh/install | sh reinstalls the verified boundary v0.2.2. After v0.3.0 assets publish and the ledger advances, the same command and clun --update target 0.3.0. Always use man clun after install; man content must match live CLI help.

sections.heading: 8. Progressive depth (not soft Yes)
sections.body: Depth limits such as full HPACK peer interop, full CDP, and V8-precise coverage maps remain progressive quality work. They do not justify hollow exports. Exported APIs perform real work rather than ignore to undefined.
